name: Temporal Pulse
text:
Aspect time

Activate 2 concentrate

Frequency once per day

---

Effect You make time shudder around you, stealing it from enemies and granting it to allies. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet must attempt a Will save save. For each creature you render Slowed with this gift, you can render one ally within 30 feet, including you, Quickened for 1 round.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Slowed 1.

Critical Failure The creature is Slowed 2.
